csv_project_name: Unsolicited (P3) - OR for Martin County Operations Facility
csv_scope_of_work: Board of County Commissioners of Martin County, Florida, is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) for professional consulting services for an Owner s Representative (OR) in connection with an unsolicited Public-Private Partnership (P3) project for the Martin County Operations Facility, consisting of a 114,000 +/- SF building. The project consists of the construction of a new 114,000 +/- square foot, single-story Maintenance and Operations Facility for Martin County. The facility will consolidate multiple departments, including Vehicle & Maintenance, General Services, Environmental Resources, Mosquito Control, Field Operations, Traffic & Signs, and Parks & Recreation, into a single, modern building. The building is designed around a central hub with multiple department wings to enhance operational efficiency and maximize vehicle access through extensive paved service areas. The structure will utilize tilt-up concrete panels designed to withstand wind speeds of up to 180 mph. The project includes complete mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems; fire protection systems; an air-cooled chiller; a backup generator; dual 15,000-gallon fuel storage tanks; and comprehensive site improvements, including concrete paving and parking areas.
